# Front of House Asset Manifest

*Generated by `npm run docs:front-of-house` (`front-of-house/tools/docs.mjs`). Do not edit by hand. CI regenerates
this file and fails if the committed copy differs. Image sizes are measured from the files; status, subject and source come from `sprites/manifest.mjs`.*

Every image, drawing and sound the game uses or keeps, with where it lives and whether it is final. To add or replace an image: put the file in `sprites/`, add it to `sprites/manifest.mjs`, add its prop to `PROPS` in `board.js` if the board draws it, then run `npm run docs:front-of-house`.

## 1. Board sprites

The board draws these over each object's footprint once all of them have decoded. If any file fails, every prop keeps its code-drawn box. *Fit* is the sprite's geometry from `PROPS` in `board.js` (`w` or `h` as a share of the footprint's screen size, `foot` where the footprint sits in the image, `lamp` the light tower's beam origin). *Box h* is the fallback box height in tiles.

Nothing draws these yet, and the service worker does not precache them. *First use* is a suggestion from [FUTURE.md](FUTURE.md#systems-and-the-first-tier-that-needs-them), not a decision. ## 3. Drawn in code

| Element | Where | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lot floor and grid | board.js | Tinted per room (FLOORS); the four venue looks are not drawn yet |
| Object boxes | board.js PROPS[].box, exported as LOOK | Fallback when a sprite fails, and the only art for a stage facing away from the viewer |
| Room pillars | board.js PILLAR | Part of the building; never placed or removed |
| Sightline overlay | board.js | Teal clear-view tiles, red blocked tiles (R-03) |
| Cursor and build ghost | board.js | Shows the footprint and whether the tile is legal |
| Night overlay and additive beams | board.js | Show night only; beams follow the drawn light tower |
| Crowd dots | board.js | A density field, not people; the crowd stamps in the library would replace them |
| Incident markers | board.js | Anchored to the drawn PA, gate or stage |

None. The header's Mute All button belongs to the shared studio navigation; Front of House plays no sound.
